title: BLACK WINGS & BLOOD SPILLED // DROGON'S DESCENT
narrative: A screaming vanguard of ten thousand Dothraki bloodriders charged across the amber grasses of the Great Grass Sea, their arakhs spinning like silver crescents. From the clouds above dropped a shadow three times larger than a galleon. Drogon roared, and a torrent of pure, unadulterated black flame bathed the Dothraki vanguard in forty yards of incinerating heat. Horses and riders turned to white ash in mid-stride, their bronze jewelry melting into molten beads. Daenerys clung to the dragon's neck spikes, her silver hair streaming in the gale, reigning supreme as the mother of the apocalypse.
